{{Quote|Come to Bosthirda with me and surrender yourself to the High Prophet himself. He can teach you things you've only dreamed of.|[[Lesser Prophet]] [[Argor]]|<ref name="Rebellion Era Sourcebook">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Bosthirda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], close to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and was located on the [[Kamat Krote]].

==History==
By the time of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Bosthirda was located in the territory of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> When the Sith Empire was [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted]] under the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], Bosthirda remained under Sith rule.<ref name="Revan" />

In [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a group of radical human [[Bosthirda separatists|separatists]] was formed, dedicated to liberating Bosthirda from the Sith Empire's rule. These separatists were used by [[Darth Nyriss]] to stage assassination attempts on herself in order to hide her conspiracy against the Sith Emperor. The Sith Emperor later sent Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] to [[Mission to Bosthirda (3954 BBY)|investigate]] the matter on Bosthirda, and he and [[Sechel]] uncovered evidence that Nyriss's fellow [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Xedrix]] was in league with the separatists. Scourge then killed Xedrix and the separatists were annihilated by Nyriss's troops.<ref name="Revan" />

By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], Bosthirda had become a hidden retreat for the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]]. There, [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Kadann]] made yearly pilgrimages to an ancient temple on Bosthirda. It was also rumored that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] once studied at the temple, although none of the Prophets confirmed such rumors.<ref name="Rebellion Era Sourcebook" /> 

When Kadann predicted [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s downfall at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Palpatine sent the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], forcing the Prophets to retreat to Bosthirda. After Palpatine's death at Endor, the Prophets plotted in secret on Bosthirda until they were found by Kadann's rogue pupil [[Azrakel]], who [[Mission to Bosthirda (Galactic Civil War)|massacred]] the Prophets along with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] and her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Carnor Jax]].<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>
